comment: Gate R mutual pinning — the peer artifact this release is measured against. The main record (data-v1.1.manifest.json) stays byte-identical to the published asset; peers are recorded here.

vdocs-data:data-v1.relation: vdocs data-v1 is the peer this release's entity bridge is built from. vdocs measured its entity-quality floors against vista-meta data-v1, not data-v1.1. data-v1.1 is a re-extraction under schema_version 1 that differs from data-v1 in two ways: xindex-xrefs location_list now carries XINDEX's TAG+n locations, and the routine source is the first pinned image (VistA-VEHU-M 62622e63, rebuilt 2026-07-04) where data-v1 used an unpinned master.zip.
